output.reason: [ev-eacfddf95197] says prometheus-operator requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0 because it uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions. The exposed environments are therefore clusters running a Kubernetes version outside ">=1.16.0". The proposed condition, cluster-version{kubernetes, out-of-range, ">=1.16.0"}, is the standard form for a compatibility-boundary requirement and matches that exactly. Whether this requirement is new in this release is part of the change, which I was not asked to verify. The rendered diffs [ev-f240b6ac3b67, ev-83fc26f44be6] are not relevant to this question.
